overview_description.description:
Polymail is the email platform for teams. By combining email with real time collaboration and integrating it with your team's other tools, Polymail allows everyone to work together seamlessly, move faster, and be more productive.

Backed by Y Combinator and based in Los Angeles, Polymail currently helps over 3,000 customers around the world communicate and collaborate more efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: Polymail is an email platform that helps teams collaborate, be more productive, and work better, together.

product.name: Polymail Email Platform
product.description: An email platform designed to enhance team collaboration and productivity through features like email tracking, contact profiles, and follow-up reminders.

product.name: Polymail Sequences
product.description: A feature that automates multi-stage email campaigns to streamline outreach and improve customer engagement.

product.name: Polymail Calendar
product.description: A scheduling tool that enables users to book meetings instantly through a personal calendar page, eliminating back-and-forth communication.

product.name: Collaboration Features (Comments and Mentions)
product.description: Tools within Polymail that allow team members to add inline comments and use @mentions in email conversations to facilitate organized communication and faster decision-making.

product.name: Email Sharing
product.description: A feature that converts email conversations into shareable web links for team viewing and collaboration.
